events.title: Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album "Definitely Maybe" on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Still sounds as fresh and defiant as it did in '94. What's your go-to track from Oasis's game-changing debut, 'Definitely Maybe'?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for three days of peace and music.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock. If you could have been there, which legendary act would you have seen?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: We remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. What's the one Elvis track that still gives you chills?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We remember the unparalleled guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost a true musical pioneer. Jimi Hendrix's legacy still burns bright. Which track showcases his genius best?

events.title: Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album "Abbey Road" on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, that incredible music. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57 this month. What's your favourite side one or side two track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are as powerful as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite moment from the voice of a generation?

events.title: Imagine: 51 years since UK single release
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Still inspiring peace and unity decades on. John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a UK single this month in '75. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod: 25 years since its unveiling
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket."

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? 25 years ago this month, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, "Dr. No," in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. So many classics – which track is your absolute favourite?
